name: AI Maturity & Learning
notes: **Added 29 September (AI functions review, the product owner's "build it right, it gets more accurate with time").** No customer is told an AI feature "comes later": every answer starts from a baseline and learns. This is where the venue sees how far each answer has come, gives the figures the baseline stands on, and imports its own history from the systems it used before TICVAI. Importing 12 months or more moves the answers it covers straight to Established.
patternReason: `listAiCapabilityMaturity` reads a population (one row per question the AI answers) and the detail is the row
purpose: See where each AI answer stands, what it is based on and what it needs next; set the venue AI profile; import the venue's own history.

components.label: Every AI answer, by stage
components.notes: Stage badge, the "Based on" line, the share of own data and what the next stage needs.

components.label: Venue AI profile
components.notes: **The venue can correct its profile at any time** — the honest answer to a baseline that is wrong for an unusual venue in the first weeks.

components.label: Import findings
components.notes: Each rejected row and why, so the venue can fix the export and import again.

components.label: Import history
components.notes: **Loaded into the AI data only, never the ledger**: an imported sale teaches the forecast and is never counted as revenue. The form says so.

states.loading: The stage of each answer; the venue profile resolves separately.
states.error: Could not load. **Every AI answer still works** — this page reports on them and changes none.
states.emptyFirstRun: **Nothing answered yet.** Every question starts at Starting from the venue AI profile and the starting pattern for the venue type. The action fills in the profile, or imports history.
states.emptyNoResults: No answer is at this stage. Names the filter and offers to clear it.
states.emptyNoAccess: You do not have AI permission at this venue. Names `AI_USE`, and `AI_CONFIGURE` for the profile and imports.

entryState.coldEntry: A link from an import-finished notification opens the import named by `importId`; without it the page opens on the maturity list.

overlays.body: **Collects what `setAiVenueSettings` sends before it is called.** Required: `venueId`, `venueType`. Any figure left empty takes the starting pattern's default for the venue type.

**Collects what `importVenueHistory` sends before it is called.** Required: `dataKind`, `assetId` (the uploaded export), `columnMapping`. Optional: `sourceSystem`, `dryRun` (check without loading). A second import of the same kind and period replaces the first.

components.label: Gross sales to net revenue
components.notes: The `waterfall` mark (CHG-FIN-007): Gross sales, minus Discounts, minus Refunds, equals Net revenue, from the same seeded KPIs as the tiles. Never gross and net stacked in one bar.

components.label: Where the money stands

states.loading: The finance measures for the chosen legal entity and period.
states.error: Could not load. Names which read failed (the measures, the money position or the tax documents) and leaves the others on screen.
states.emptyFirstRun: No postings for this period yet. Offers no create action: a dashboard has nothing to create; it says which period is empty and offers the previous one.
states.emptyNoResults: The venue or product category filter matched no sales in the period. Names the active filter and offers to clear it.
states.emptyNoAccess: Shown when the caller lacks `LEDGER_VIEW`, which the money position and tax documents require, and names that permission. **Never an empty table** — that reads as *there is no data*.

wireframe.workshopBoard: wireframes/WS163 TICVAI Finance Backend Structure Reference v1.0 Board 1.dc.html#bo-1081
wireframe.note: The client's workshop frame for this dashboard is the one drawn for BO-1081 (the same pack, board 1, number 1), whose content ANL-072 carries since DEC-219 (CHG-SOT-008; CHG-GTB-006).

notes: **Issued 2 October 2026 (CHG-SOT-008, DEC-219).** The Finance standard dashboard of the one reporting area (DI-721), carrying DI-260's content from BO-1081, which becomes a link card on Orders & Money (P08, the back-office agent's change). The design notes of BO-1081 (finance-insights) apply here in full: tile order, definitions, the money-position sentence, tax-document counts and freshness. **Measure names, not "Revenue"** (CHG-FIN-002): Gross sales, Net revenue, Recognised revenue and Deferred revenue never share a label, and the tiles never bind `takings`. **One reporting area, one set of numbers** (CHG-FIN-006): this screen reads the same seeded KPIs as the till report (POS-008) and the back-office reports for the same scope, period and as-of time, computes no total of its own and shows the as-of time on every figure. **The guard is the frontend comparison test TEST-SAME-NUMBERS** (decided 2 October 2026, DEC-559; `docs/active/block-a-extra-tasks.json`), which compares takings, gross sales, net revenue and refunds here with POS-008 and the back office for the same period and scope, and fails when they differ.

gaps.why: **No service-fee measure is seeded.** DEC-217 shows fees as their own line under Gross sales with a footnote; `ReportingSystemKpi` has no fee code yet, so the line is drawn "Definition pending" until finance names one (D-185).
